'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 709
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>If a man carried my burden, he would break his back. I am not rich, but leave silver in my track. Speak to the keeper of my trail.
|items = 
|notes = Speak to [[Gerrant]] in the [[Port Sarim]] [[Gerrant's Fishy Business.|fish shop]]. 
The clue's text is a reference to him giving you [[blamish snail slime]]: a snail carries its house around as a human cannot, and leaves the silvery slime trail.
